In 2019, a delegation from Evansville visited Osnabrück to celebrate the 57th anniversary of their sister city partnership. The visit included a ceremony at Osnabrück's City Hall, where officials from both cities reaffirmed their commitment to the partnership. As the world becomes increasingly interconnected, the bond between Osnabrück and Evansville serves as a shining example of the benefits of international cooperation and friendship.
